draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher than Arbor-GBT on 5 of 6 datasets (r1,r2,r4,r5,r6), lower only on r3. "Generally" accurately reflects this majority pattern across the six-dataset suite. No statistical test reported, but "generally" does not claim significance.
